description: Retry a stuck USDC sell in place, reusing its transaction nonce so it cannot execute twice. Use when usdc_wait_for_trade returns needs_retry (or funding status shows retry.available). Token, amount, chain and nonce are read from the backend's retry capability; re-quote the sell for minUsdcOutRaw.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

apiKey.description: GDEX API key for AES encryption

minUsdcOutRaw.description: Minimum USDC out (re-quote with usdc_get_trade_quote side sell), raw integer units

name: usdc_retry_sell
